correctness.rationale: Smoothness and exact line criterion are proved algebraically. Complete and unique enumeration of 605242 RREF 2-planes over F9 gives 82 contained lines; full finite-field rank computation gives 350 intersections, degrees, 190 triangles, and connectedness. Standalone stdlib script was freshly executed successfully with VERIFY_OK. The cyclic-invariant pair has an independent semisimple representation argument. No extrapolation beyond GF9.

value.rationale: The natural incidence correspondence on the Fano surface is finer than point-count/zeta data. Its first quadratic-extension rational graph has a nonregular connected structure and 190 triangles absent from the base-field graph; the two skew Frobenius-conjugate invariant lines have a motivated representation-theoretic explanation. These exact structural invariants support concrete follow-up study of arithmetic Fano incidence and symmetry.
